messages.subject: get_attribute Renders NA
parts:
I am new to simmer-r and am trying to set an attribute in one trajectory, get the generated attribute in another trajectory, and set a new attribute. However, when I tried to get this newly created attribute, no value was created and I get NA. I was wondering if there is something wrong with my code?

Below I provided an example

Thanks in advance for your help.

,,,

library(simmer)
 env <- simmer() 
gg <- trajectory("G's path") %>% set_attribute("ga_score", function() 2)

 p <- trajectory("P's path") %>% set_attribute("pa_score", function() 10) %>% set_attribute("mult",function() get_attribute(env,"pa_score") * get_attribute(env,"ga_score")) %>% timeout(function() 5) %>% log_(function() paste0('the attribute is:', get_attribute(env,"mult"))) 

envv %>% add_generator(name_prefix = "P's sim ", trajectory = p, distribution = function() 5,mon = 2) %>% run(until = 40)

,,,

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] get_attribute Renders NA
parts:
In your example, your arrivals only visit P's path, not G's path, so ga_score is undefined and thus you get NA.

Iñaki

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] get_attribute Renders NA
parts:
On Sun, 10 Jan 2021 at 18:44, Seyed Hosseini <sask...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Iñaki,
Thanks for your response. is not the same thing that happens in gas station example?
so refueling trajectory get level attribute that is set in car trajectory and then only car generator is added to env ?

In that example, the car trajectory does join(refuelling). So the arrival is attached to the car trajectory, but refuelling is contained in the car trajectory (you can print the car trajectory and you'll see the whole chain of activities).

--
Iñaki Úcar
